title: Probing Perceptual Priors of MLLMs via Gibbs Sampling with Interpretable Generative Controls
reasoning: The paper proposes a method to probe perceptual priors in multimodal language models using Gibbs sampling, focusing on evaluating domains such as faces, affordances, aesthetics, and authenticity. It uncovers demographic biases but does not evaluate or benchmark religion, ethics, or moral reasoning.
